introduction:
In Karnataka, the Caste Certificate (ಜಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಪತ್ರ) is an official document issued by the Revenue Department (Tahsildar) to citizens belonging to specific reservation categories (SC, ST, OBC, etc.). It is mandatory for availing education benefits, government jobs, and various welfare schemes.

Applications can be processed online through the upgraded Nadakacheri 5.0 portal or offline at local offices like Atalji Janasnehi Kendras.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Certificate: Caste Certificate (ಜಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಪತ್ರ).
  • Platform: Nadakacheri 5.0 (ನಾಡಕಛೇರಿ) portal.
  • Application Fee: ₹40 (for online payment).
  • Processing Time: Within 21 days.
  • Eligibility: Citizens belonging to specific reservation categories (SC, ST, OBC, etc.) in Karnataka.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

Note: All documents must be uploaded in PDF format and should be under 300 KB in size. The passport-size photo must be under 50 KB.
Academic & Family Proofs
  • School Document (ಶಾಲಾ ದಾಖಲೆ / TC - Transfer Certificate).
  • Ration Card (ಪಡಿತರ ಚೀಟಿ).
  • Old Caste Certificate (ಹಳೆ ಜಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಪತ್ರ) if applicable.
Identity & Photos
  • Identity Proof (ಗುರುತಿನ ಚೀಟಿ) - Voter ID or Aadhaar Card.
  • Address Proof (ವಿಳಾಸದ ಪುರಾವೆ) - Aadhaar Card.
  • Passport-size Photograph (ಪಾಸ್ ಪೋರ್ಟ್ ಸೈಜಿನ ಫೋಟೋ) - under 50 KB.
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Online Application via Nadakacheri 5.0 Portal

Follow these steps to submit your application online from home:

  1. Login: Visit the official Nadakacheri Portal and click on the "Login_Public" option.
  2. OTP Verification: Enter your mobile number, click on "Get OTP" (ಓಟಿಪಿ ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ), enter the received OTP, and click "Login" (ಲಾಗಿನ್).
  3. Select Language: Choose your preferred language (Kannada or English).
  4. Select Service: Hover over "New Request" (ಹೊಸ ವಿನಂತಿ) and click on "Caste Certificate" (ಜಾತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಪತ್ರ), then select it again from the sub-menu.
  5. Proceed: A list of required documents is shown. Click "Proceed" (ಮುಂದುವರೆಸಿ).
  6. Identity Check: Choose if you have a Ration Card (Yes/No). If yes, enter the Ration Card number and click proceed. If no, enter your Aadhaar number and name.
  7. Search Applicant: Select the applicant's name from the dropdown (fetched from the Ration Card records) and click "Search" (ಶೋಧಿಸು).
  8. Fill Personal Details: Input District, Taluk, Rural/Urban area, Hobli, Village/Town, Ward, Title, Applicant's Name, Father's/Husband's Name, Mother's Name, Address, and Pincode.
  9. Contact Verification: Verify both your Mobile Number and Email ID using separate OTPs (via "Send OTP" buttons). Click "Next" (ಮುಂದಿನದು).
  10. Caste & Category: Select your Reservation Category (ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ವರ್ಗ), specific Caste (ಜಾತಿ), Total Annual Family Income, and certificate purpose. Click "Next".
  11. Upload Files: Upload your passport photo (under 50 KB) and all required PDF documents (each under 300 KB). Click the PDF icon next to the uploaded files to verify.
  12. Submit & Reference: Click "Submit" (ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿ). An Application Reference Number (RD Number) will be generated. Keep this safe.
  13. Aadhaar e-Sign: Click "Proceed to e-Sign" (ಇ ಸಹಿಗೆ ಮುಂದುವರೆಯಿರಿ). Enter your Aadhaar number, authenticate via OTP, accept the consent, and submit.
  14. Payment: Click "Proceed to Pay" (ಹಣ ಪಾವತಿಸಲು ಮುಂದುವರೆಯಿರಿ). Accept terms and conditions, choose a payment gateway (e.g. PhonePe), scan the QR code, and pay the ₹40 fee.
Offline Visit Alternative: If you cannot navigate the online portal yourself, visit a nearby Common Service Centre (CSC) or a cyber cafe where an operator will complete this online process for you.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Apply Offline at Local Offices

  1. Visit Centre: Go to the nearest Atalji Janasnehi Kendra (Nadakacheri office located at the Hobli level), Taluk Office, or the Village Accountant's office.
  2. Get Application Form: Obtain the Caste Certificate application form from the office counter.
  3. Fill Out Form: Complete the application with accurate details like name, parents' names, caste category, and address.
  4. Attach Documents: Attach photocopies of all required files (Ration Card, School TC, Aadhaar/Voter ID, address proof, passport photo, and old caste certificate if any).
  5. Submit Application: Present the completed form and documents to the designated officer or Nadakacheri operator.
  6. Pay Fee: Pay the prescribed processing fee directly at the counter.
  7. Collect Receipt: Collect the acknowledgment receipt containing your Application Reference Number (RD Number) to track progress.
afterApplying:
After Applying & Verification

  • Field Verification: Once the fee is paid, your application is forwarded to the Village Administrative Officer (VA) or Revenue Inspector for verification. They may call your mobile or inspect documents.
  • Approval Cycle: The certificate is generally approved and generated within 21 days.
  • Download & Print: After approval, log back into the Nadakacheri portal, check status using the RD number, and select "Print Certificate" to download and print the document. No SRO or office visit is needed to collect the physical copy.
